supplementalManifest.protocol: production Personal prompt; EQ evaluator system context delivered as labeled user-message context on each turn; no persona cards or judge data exposed
limitations: EQ sampled pointwise trait profile, not official pairwise leaderboard rating
One judge and one simulated-user model; results depend on both
FollowBench style adherence is not conversational naturalness
No production history, user memory, connectors or external side effects
Model-catalog cost estimates are not billing receipts
One capture per condition; no statistical significance or real-user satisfaction claim
Diagnostic scripts are not an independent holdout; original EQ scenes were used in prior analysis
Two display orders use the same judge model; neither independent judges nor human ground truth
EQ whole-dialogue trajectories can diverge; fixed Chinese scripts are not adaptive user simulations
Neutral EQ trait means are not a scalar quality grade or official leaderboard result
Original transport errors remain immutable; supplemental grades reuse captured answers
Cloud aliases do not pin underlying backend weights; billing cost unavailable

firstVariantDevelopmentDiagnostics.protocolChangeDisclosed: The first plan prohibited tuning on its diagnostics; this refinement explicitly changes that plan after a failed gate, preserves the failed variant and uses new frozen validation scripts. This is a new source variant, not a result-selected retry of the same source. Full v1 partial results are not spliced into v2.
